definitions.full: H4262. machmud or machmod [ מַחְמֹד ] noun [masculine] desirable, precious thing ; — מַחֲמֻדֶיהָ Lam 1:7 , מַחֲמוֺדֵיהֶם 1:11 Kt (Qr מַחֲמַדֵּיהֶם ). Perhaps ׳מַחֲמַדּ to be read in both; compare Sta § 273 a . I. חמה (√ of following; compare Arabic protect, guard , RS K 136 Lag BN 156 ; Dl Pr 91; BAS ii. 43 compare an Assyrian ê mû, surround , guard , compare Modern Syriac id. ; Ethiopic III. 1 means contract affinity, be joined by affinity , probably denominative)
